title: Helmet.js and CORS configuration
description: Apply Helmet.js for HTTP security headers and configure CORS to allow only the frontend origin. This hardens the API against common web vulnerabilities.
acceptanceCriteria: CORS allows credentials (for cookie-based refresh tokens)
OPTIONS preflight requests return correct CORS headers

steps.details: In server/src/index.ts, add app.use(helmet()) before other middleware. Helmet sets: X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, X-Frame-Options: DENY, X-XSS-Protection: 0 (modern browsers handle this), Strict-Transport-Security (HTTPS only), Content-Security-Policy.

Replace generic cors() with configured version: app.use(cors({ origin: process.env.FRONTEND_URL || 'http://localhost:5173', credentials: true, methods: ['GET','POST','PUT','PATCH','DELETE','OPTIONS'], allowedHeaders: ['Content-Type', 'Authorization'] })). This allows the frontend to send cookies with requests.

Use curl -I http://localhost:3000/api/health — verify X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options headers are present. Make a request from the frontend origin — verify no CORS errors in browser console. Make a request from a different origin — verify CORS blocks it.

technicalNotes: credentials: true in CORS requires a specific origin (not *) — wildcard + credentials is not allowed
CORS preflight (OPTIONS) must be handled before auth middleware — apply cors() before requireAuth
